 Bolex Reporter, Volume 9
 Winter 1958
 Volume 9, Number 1
 Articles: "Ten Tips for Winter Movies"; "Superimpose Your Titles"; "An Introduction to Home Movies", Raymond C. Lawson; "Winter Project: Silhouette Movies", Russell T. Christopher; "Hunting with a Bolex", Warren Page; "Movie of an Inanimate Subject", Paul Dana; "Composition for Wide Screen Movies", Ernst Wildi
 The results of the Bolex Film Festival are announced. Raymond C. Lawson begins the first in a ten part series of articles on home movie making; these articles were later compiled into a small booklet of the same name.
 32 pages
 Spring 1959
 Volume 9, Number 2
 Articles: "Plan A Travelogue", Derek Hill; "Through the Kaleidoscope", Weegee; "An Introduction to Home Movies (Part II)", Raymond C. Lawson; "Let Color Work For You", Barton Ford; "Now is the Time to Start Family Movies", Ted Russell; "Decamired Color Filter System", Ernst Wildi; "Show Growth and Change with Time Lapse", Jack Ruddell; "The Money Machine", Ray Dantzler; "Spring Service", Fred Onderka; "Animated Cartoon TV Commercials with Bolex", David Bennett
 Weegee returns to discuss more of his kaleidoscope filming technique. The H-16 REX, C-8SL, B-8SL, rexofader and switar 13mm f/0.9 are introduced and reviewed.
 32 pages
 Summer 1959
 Volume 9, Number 3
 Articles: "How to Edit Your Films", Jack Ruddell; "Bolex Goes to a 'Fiesta de Toros'", Vincent Kehoe; "An Introduction to Home Movies (Part III)", Raymond C. Lawson; "Come On In! The Water's Fine", Ray Dantzler; "Mom Films a Birthday Greeting", Lou Lachter; "Movies Help Teach Water Skills", Harold Hainfeld; "...Of Sailing Boats and Movie Films...", Lloyd S. Jones; "Make Animated Cartoons With Your Bolex", Fredric Stoessell; "Bolex Helps Keep Pace With Space Age", Lt. Cecil Stoughton; "How to Make Fades, Wipes, Dissolves", Ernst Wildi; "Stairway to the Stars", Tom Sulliivan
 This summer issue is full of tips for the amateur and professional Bolex user. The new D-8L and Pan Cinor 85 is introduced.
 32 pages
 Fall 1959
 Volume 9, Number 4
 Articles: "Take Movies From Your Car", George Nagorsky; "Available Light Movies", David S. Brown; "Make-Up for Home Movies", Barton Ford; "Filming a Speech Camp", Bob Newman; "...The Best is Yet to Come (Fall Movies)", Alan Arnold; "Movies: Tool For Football Coaches", Harold Hainfeld; "Sports Cars on Film", Myron A. Matzkin; "Shoot a Solar Eclipse", Peter Leavens; "How to Make Sharp 8mm Movies", Ernst Wildi; "Camera Magic", Tom Sullivan; "An Introduction to Home Movies (Part IV), Raymond C. Lawson; "Creative Use of Lenses", Ira Latour
 The Declic D, Tripod H, Unimotor MC-17, Pan Cinor 30L (8mm), Pizar 50mm f/1.8 and Switar 36mm f/1.8 (d mount) is introduced.
 32 pages
